prompt:
Create one high-resolution 2D game environment sprite for the exact isolated straight wall segment in reference 1. Return a true transparent RGBA portrait canvas with aspect ratio 2:3, preferably 1024 by 1536. Reference 1 is a fixed 256 by 384 logical-pixel canvas, not a bounding-box crop. Keep its entire canvas mapping, placement, scale, view, sloping silhouette, two vertical cut interfaces, roof/coping depth, wall height, and foundation contour. The source segment occupies logical bounding rectangle [32,20,224,365]. Do not center or fit the object by its opaque bounding box. Do not thicken, widen, rotate, mirror, shear, bend, flatten or extend it.

Reference 2 is READ-ONLY ADJACENCY CONTEXT. It contains a left copy of the same wall and a right concave corner at their exact original world positions. Only the target source segment [192,96,384,441] in that context corresponds to reference 1. Output the isolated segment from reference 1 only. Both cut ends are continuation interfaces, not exposed end walls. Do not close either end, add an end cap, copy the corner into the target, or output the entire context. Do not paint black or grey background.

Reference 3 shows the whole accepted house and is MATERIAL AND DAYLIGHT ONLY. Ignore its footprint, roof silhouette, upturned eaves, gable, doors, windows, vents and blue light; do not reproduce any of those features. Its only role is restrained Earth-era human martial-arts training-base architecture, with dark graphite standing-seam metal, clean neutral-grey concrete, and small practical gunmetal structural details. Use these materials to fully redraw the old tile roof, brick wall and yellow rubble foundation. Retain all source geometry and the original relative depth of coping/roof, wall and footing. Roof/coping seams must be broad enough to read as modern metal, not dense antique tiles. Concrete should be calm, believable and sharply resolved, without dense procedural noise. Keep the same fixed game-view angle and lighting direction, no perspective vanishing point or depth of field. Use realistic high-resolution 2D painting suitable for native game rendering, not 3D-rendered imagery, not pixel art and not enlarged pixels.

The separate source crop ownership is a technical slicing constraint, not an architectural panel grid. Do not invent seams every 48 logical pixels. All surfaces must remain visually continuous across those invisible internal boundaries. Both ends must be suitable for a repeated continuation at world translation (+192,-128) or (-192,+128), preserving the exact original endpoint positions and material heights. Do not reposition the endpoints to make an ideal mathematical parallelogram. Do not reduce the roof depth or raise the wall as happened in the earlier corner research.

Do not add doors, windows, lights, glowing blue edge lines, signs, fencing, pillars, standalone objects, vegetation, ground, a ground shadow, extra background fragments, or small stray alpha specks. Do not copy a house silhouette or doorway from the material reference. Preserve source transparent-edge placement naturally in the redraw; do not create an image that needs an old low-resolution mask to cut away newly invented structure. Output only this one coherent complete wall segment, no sheet, labels, comparison board or multiple variants.
